caveats: SST used as stored (float32, kelvin), promoted to float64 for statistics. Sea cells: 3304 of 3600 region cells (finite on all analysed days). Threshold/climatology pools from baseline dates 1992-01-01..2002-12-31 with +/-5-day windows (1991-12-27..2003-01-05); day 60 filled from days 59/61; both smoothed with circular 31-day mean. Hot day: SST >= threshold (hazen 90th percentile). Per-cell MHW: >=5 hot days, gaps of 1-2 days joined. Regional events from daily max over sea cells: 1 event, 9 active days of 92.
